mission.description: Route START(-2002,708.0) -> DEST(-251.0,-1275) via A (NIAS Guest House Cafe) at (-2217, 430.3), B (JRD Tata Memorial Library) at (-1962, -989.0), C (Chemical Engineering) at (-1542, -914.5). Order: visit A before B; visit B before C. Altitude 920.1-1080.5 m at all waypoints. No entry to or crossing of BLD_way_314078092 [building (height tag), convex hull] [blocks only altitudes from ground up to 965.9 m; above that it can be overflown], BLD_way_314078500 [building (height tag), convex hull] [blocks only altitudes from ground up to 965.2 m; above that it can be overflown], BLD_way_1263542131 [building (height tag), convex hull] [blocks only altitudes from ground up to 974 m; above that it can be overflown], BLD_345861400 [building (levels), convex hull] [blocks only altitudes from ground up to 976.7 m; above that it can be overflown]. Total length <= 3847 meters. Battery: 7021 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is Multi Purpose Block; DEST is RRI Light and Matter Physics.) Coordinates are meters east/north of 13.0252 N, 77.5840 E; altitudes are meters above sea level; the ground here lies between 900 and 960 m, and every leg must stay 20-120 m above the ground.
